hours.note: The kitchen takes its last order at 10:30 pm.

hero.lead: Four courses that change with the season, cooked in the open kitchen and served without rush. A jazz trio plays on Thursdays; the rest of the week the room stays quiet. Bookings open three weeks ahead.

mushroomSoup.name: Wild mushroom cream soup
mushroomSoup.desc: Porcini and chanterelles cooked in butter, cream from Rășinari, parsley oil and a lovage leaf on top.
mushroomSoup.alt: Cream soup in a black ceramic bowl with a green leaf on top

beefSoup.name: Beef soup with hand-cut noodles
beefSoup.desc: Simmered four hours on the bone, with root vegetables and noodles kneaded that morning. Cream on request.
beefSoup.alt: Bowl of soup with noodles, served with a fork alongside

chickenSoup.name: Chicken soup with egg and lovage
chickenSoup.desc: Farm chicken, thickened with egg and sharpened with preserved lemon. The lovage goes in at the table.
chickenSoup.alt: Bowl of soup with egg and herbs

lobster.name: Lobster with morel cream
lobster.desc: Lobster tail seared in seaweed butter, spring morels, white asparagus and basil.
lobster.alt: Lobster and morels on a black plate with a gold rim

risotto.name: Prawn and dill risotto
risotto.desc: Carnaroli rice, shellfish stock reduced for four hours, red prawns and dill oil.
risotto.alt: Deep plate of risotto with prawns and dill on a wooden table

tagliatelle.name: Tagliatelle with porcini
tagliatelle.desc: Dough kneaded in the morning and cut by hand, porcini from the Cindrel mountains cooked in butter, fresh parsley and aged cheese grated over it at the table.
tagliatelle.alt: Tagliatelle twirled on a fork above a black bowl

sashimi.name: Nigiri and sashimi platter
sashimi.desc: Bluefin tuna and Faroe salmon, rice seasoned with red vinegar, wasabi grated at your table.
sashimi.alt: Black platter of nigiri and sashimi with chopsticks

rolls.name: Salmon and avocado rolls
rolls.desc: Faroe salmon, ripe avocado, rice with red vinegar and soy sauce fermented in house.
rolls.alt: Salmon and avocado sushi rolls on a wooden board

potatoes.name: New potatoes with butter and dill
potatoes.desc: Baked in their skins until they split, with farm butter and dill cut at the last moment.
potatoes.alt: Roasted potatoes and yellow beans with fresh herbs

parsnip.name: Roast parsnip with thyme
parsnip.desc: Cut thick and roasted until the edges caramelise, with thyme and a drop of linden honey.
parsnip.alt: Roasted parsnip batons with thyme in a bowl

sprouts.name: Brussels sprouts with burnt cream
sprouts.desc: Pan-roasted until they open leaf by leaf, with cream burnt on the stove and toasted walnuts.
sprouts.alt: Crispy brussels sprouts with a creamy white sauce

salad.name: Seasonal salad in a ring
salad.desc: Vegetables from three gardens in Mărginime, laid in a ring, with pumpkin seed oil and sheep's cheese.
salad.alt: Gourmet salad arranged in a ring on a plate

chocolate.name: Chocolate sphere, gold leaf
chocolate.desc: 72% chocolate, raspberry centre, sea salt. Broken open at the table with warm sauce.
chocolate.alt: Two desserts with fruit, ice cream and pastry

cake.name: Chocolate cake with raspberries
cake.desc: Three thin layers, 72% chocolate cream and raspberries from Sibiel, picked in July.
cake.alt: Slice of chocolate cake with cream and raspberries

tiramisu.name: House tiramisu
tiramisu.desc: Mascarpone beaten by hand, sponge soaked in speciality coffee and cocoa sifted over it at the table.
tiramisu.alt: Slice of tiramisu dusted with cocoa, beside a glass

wineRed.name: Fetească neagră, by the glass
wineRed.desc: From Dealu Mare, 2021. Poured from a carafe after twenty minutes of air.
wineRed.alt: Dark liquid in a crystal glass

wineWhite.name: Fetească regală from Jidvei, by the glass
wineWhite.desc: Dry, with high acidity. It goes with the raw fish and with the sour soups.
wineWhite.alt: Wine bottles and a glass beside flowers

cellar.name: From the cellar, by the bottle
cellar.desc: A hundred and eighty labels, forty of them Romanian. The sommelier picks, if you say what you are eating.
cellar.alt: Wine bottles in a diamond-shaped wooden rack

tartare.name: Beef tartare with horseradish
tartare.desc: Sirloin cut by knife that morning, turkey yolk, grated horseradish and bread toasted on the stove.
tartare.alt: Beef tartare with olives, bread and tomatoes

bread.name: Sourdough bread with farm butter
bread.desc: Baked every morning from the house starter, with whipped butter and Praid salt. It arrives warm.
bread.alt: Rustic loaf on a black metal table

duck.name: Duck with quince
duck.desc: Farm duck salted for a day, then five hours in the cooling oven, with quince from Cisnădioara.
duck.alt: A piece of meat with sauce on a white plate

salmon.name: Grilled salmon with asparagus
salmon.desc: Four minutes over beech embers, with green asparagus, thinly sliced radishes and preserved lemon butter.
salmon.alt: Grilled salmon with asparagus and radishes on a plate

polenta.name: Polenta with sheep's cheese
polenta.desc: Corn milled at Rășinari, cooked in a cauldron and stirred through with burduf cheese in front of you.
polenta.alt: White bowl of yellow polenta on a wooden table

carrots.name: Roast carrots with honey and thyme
carrots.desc: Roasted whole until the edges wrinkle, with linden honey, thyme and buffalo yoghurt underneath.
carrots.alt: Roasted carrots and salad in metal bowls

strip.events: Live jazz on Thursdays · wine dinner, first Tuesday of the month

platter.title: The same platter since the first night.
platter.bodyOne: When we opened, the kitchen had one dish everybody ordered: eight pieces of raw fish, cut in front of the guest and laid on a stone plate. We never took it off the menu and never changed its shape.
platter.bodyTwo: The plates are cut from stone out of a quarry in Mărginime and wear down over years, not months. Exactly eight pieces fit on each, because that is what two people get through before the fish warms up. The order is yours — most start with the white fish and work towards the fatty cuts, but nobody will correct you.
platter.alt: Slices of raw fish laid on a round stone plate, seen from above
platter.statSince: on the list since the first night

signature.title: Three plates people come back for

testimonials.title: Our guests write better than we do.
testimonials.rating: 4.9 out of 5, from 412 verified reviews over the last 18 months.

one.quote: We came for an anniversary and left with a booking for the following month. The service is precise to the second without ever feeling stiff.
one.name: Andreea Mihalache

two.quote: The sashimi platter is the best I have eaten outside Tokyo. I say that after eleven years of travelling there.
two.name: Victor Ionescu

three.quote: I brought four clients to dinner. The contract was signed the next day. I am not saying the two are connected, but I am not denying it either.
three.name: Raluca Pavel

closing.title: The rest is told at the table.
closing.note: Daily, 10:00 am–11:30 pm. Bookings open three weeks ahead.

menu.title: The menu
menu.lead: The house carte, the same every day. Soups go on the fire in the morning, the sides follow the market, and anything from the oven is cooked to order.
menu.metaDescription: Starters, soups, mains, sides, desserts and wines by the glass, from an open kitchen in Sibiu.
menu.nutritionLegend: Values per portion. P protein, F fat, C carbohydrate, in grams.

allergies.title: Allergies and diets
allergies.body: Tell your waiter what you avoid. They know what goes into every dish and will say on the spot what can be swapped — plenty of them work without dairy, or without gluten.

groups.title: Groups
groups.body: Up to six, come whenever suits you. From seven up, call ahead: there is only one long table and it books quickly.

prices.title: Prices
prices.body: VAT included. No service charge is added to the bill; the tip is yours to decide.

menu.askUs: Looking for something else? <link>Write or call us</link> and we will tell you what can be cooked tonight.

about.title: An open kitchen and a room that keeps quiet.
about.lead: We opened in 2009 with six tables in a courtyard in Sibiu. The room has grown to eighteen since, but the menu has had only small adjustments — the dishes from that first night are still on the card.
about.storyOne: At the start there were three of us: a cook, a hand and someone who answered the phone. Six tables, one stove and one oven. People kept coming back for the same few dishes, so those stayed.
about.storyTwo: The kitchen opens straight onto the room, with no glass and no curtain. Guests see everything, mistakes included. It keeps us honest and, on a good night, makes a better show than any music would.
about.storyThree: We work with twenty-three producers from Mărginimea Sibiului and the Hârtibaciu valley. We have known most of them for more than ten years. When one has nothing in a given week, we change the side, not the supplier and not the dish.
about.imageAlt: Cast iron pan on the stove in the open kitchen
about.principlesTitle: Three things we never cut short.

fire.title: One fire
fire.body: The oven is lit at two in the afternoon with beech wood and stays lit until the last order. Everything that leaves the kitchen warm has passed through it, dessert included.

pantry.title: The autumn pantry
pantry.body: In September we put up four hundred jars. In winter the sharpness on the plate comes from those, not from lemons flown in.

room.title: One seating
room.body: We do not turn tables. A seven o'clock booking is yours until we close, even if you spend three hours over coffee.

about.quote: My grandmother had no recipes. She had a pantry and a calendar. We kept both and added a better oven.
about.metaDescription: Eighteen tables, an open kitchen and twenty-three producers from Mărginimea Sibiului, since 2009.

contact.title: Call us. Someone from the room picks up.
contact.lead: Bookings are made by phone or email and confirmed the same day. For Friday and Saturday evenings, call two or three weeks ahead.
contact.phoneNote: The surest way. We answer between 10:00 am and 10:00 pm.
contact.emailNote: For groups over six or anything out of the ordinary.

entrance.title: The entrance
entrance.body: The wooden gate at number 14 opens onto a courtyard. Walk through it and take the second door, the one with the lantern lit. There is no sign on the street.

parking.title: Parking
parking.body: Six places in the courtyard, first come first served. Otherwise the Piața Mică car park is four minutes on foot and free after eight in the evening.

events.title: Private events
events.body: The small room seats fourteen and is let whole, with a menu written together. Write to us at least three weeks ahead.

contact.metaDescription: 14 Cetății Street, Sibiu. Bookings by phone or email, daily between 10:00 am and 11:30 pm.
